label: Landslide: how far the slope slides (0 where it holds)

inputs.name: pgv
inputs.description: PGV at the component, in cm/s: the shaking the occurrence model reads.

inputs.name: pga
inputs.description: PGA at the component, in g: below the model's floor the ground does not fail.

source.citation: Nowicki Jessee et al. (2018) JGR Earth Surface 123:1835, USGS slim form (code.usgs.gov ghsc/esi/groundfailure, jessee_2018.py and jessee_2018_slim.py, commit fa7bd28). Given it occurs: Jibson (2007) Engineering Geology 91:209, Eq. 6, as OpenQuake implements it (openquake/sep/landslide/displacement.py, commit 0f9c75e).

description: PGD > 0 only if the slope fails and slides: the slope fails with P = 1 - (1 - f)^(L / patch), f = Nowicki Jessee et al. (2018)'s areal coverage at x0 + b_pgv ln PGV' + b_int ln PGV' x slope, PGV' = min(PGV, clip), 0 below its PGA floor; it slides only where r = ac / PGA < 1 (Newmark). Given both, log10 PGD(cm) ~ N(c1 + log10((1 - r)^c2 r^c3), sigma_log10), r floored at ratio_min (Jibson 2007 Eq. 6). Else PGD = 0. Occurrence (the ground moved) is the event PGD > 0.
